Currently the package depends on libraries that are only runnable inside a node.js environment. This is problematic when ran inside a browser, or inside any other container not having node.js. It is necessary to decouple node and this package as it should not be needed. Two main culprits:
- ubiquibot-logger
- fs
These should be removed from this package. Also, the output should be bundled.
